fusions.name: Gliding Descent
fusions.desc: Glides you to a target up to 7 tiles away, then lands on it for 12 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Languid Wingbeat
fusions.desc: A slow beat of your flippers sends out a swell, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles with a 35% chance to leave each [Leaden] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Surfacing Breath
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands. You regain 10 health at once.

fusions.name: Riding the Thermal
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
